note: Adapted from the species description of Scheffrahn (2016), originally in English; the alate is unknown and only the soldier and worker are described; measurements are those given in the descriptive text; type locality, distribution and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Monotypic. Head capsule and pronotum pale orange brown, nasus darker. In dorsal view the cephalic gland tube is partly or completely visible from the nasus to the reservoir. Head with many short setae, some medium setae and a few longer setae; setae on the nasus short and numerous. Head capsule (excluding nasus) oval in dorsal view; nasus about equal in length to 2/3 of the remaining head capsule; head capsule scarcely constricted behind the antennal fossae, widest at midlength. Vertex almost flat in profile; vertex and ventral margin of the head capsule convergent anteriorly. Nasus narrowly conical in dorsal view, basal width about three times the width at midlength; nasus conical in profile, projecting forward directly below the plane of the vertex. Mandibles short and very narrow apically. Antennae 12-segmented (1>2<3=4). Hind tibia about equal to or shorter than maximum head width. Pronotum with scattered microscopic setae (0.05 mm); anterior lobe evenly convex, at about 90° to the plane of the posterior lobe; posterior lobe blunter. Tergites with 3–4 long setae (0.13 mm) and several tens of microscopic setae (0.05 mm). Enteric valve with three irregular rows of about 8–12 long, subtriangular, slightly decurved spines; a few small scale-like spines in the anterior ring.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Monotypic. Head capsule very pale yellow with two slightly darker yellow-orange dorsolateral patches; pronotum very pale yellow; body, antennae and legs hyaline. Antennae 12–13-segmented. Postclypeus rather inflated in profile; head capsule with scattered short and medium setae and a few longer setae. Abdomen with many short setae and longer setae. Mandibular grinding plate with about eight ridges and a shallow dorsal concavity; apical tooth and first marginal tooth similar in shape and prominence; third marginal tooth smaller, separated from the first marginal tooth by a slightly concave cutting edge. P1 of the gut very long; U-shaped flexure near midlength, the bottom of the flexure reaching the ventral side of the abdomen. Enteric valve with three irregular rows of about 8–12 long, subtriangular, slightly decurved spines; three patches of small scale-like spines in the anterior ring.
